name: v4.26.1
body:
## Bug Fixes

- send_message reports "Press Enter to Send" and explains how to switch that setting. ([#1109](https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/pull/1109) by @Ymx1ZQ)
- Keep an open chat overlay from blocking connect_with_person invitations. ([#1110](https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/pull/1110) by @Ymx1ZQ)
- Avoid needless browser setup when Patchright versions share the cache. ([#1162](https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/pull/1162))
- Recover browser setup when Windows AppContainer grants block the default temp directory. ([#1163](https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/pull/1163))

## Install or update

> [!TIP]
> New here? The [README](https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server#readme) covers setup.

### Update with uvx

Clients configured with `mcp-server-linkedin@latest` pick up v4.26.1 on their next start. To pin this release, use `mcp-server-linkedin@4.26.1` instead.

### Update with the MCP Bundle

For Claude Desktop, download [linkedin-mcp-server-v4.26.1.mcpb](https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/releases/download/v4.26.1/linkedin-mcp-server-v4.26.1.mcpb) and open it to install or update. Bundles do not update themselves, so repeat this for every release.

### Update with Docker

```bash
docker pull stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server:latest
```

Use the `4.26.1` tag instead of `latest` to pin this release.
